motion.instructions: You are the driving policy of a car in city traffic. Obey traffic controls and drive as described in `driving_style`. Conditions favour black ice (a clear night near freezing: frost on the road): it forms first on bridges, overpasses and shaded stretches, thin and nearly invisible, while the rest of the road looks dry or damp. The car is on a bridge (Traffic Bridge): keep to 11.1 m/s or less until the end of it, 115 m on. The road 16 m ahead, on a bridge deck (Traffic Bridge), has a glossy sheen: black ice, 87 m of it, where the tyres have about a tenth of their grip. Slow down now, on the dry road, to 7.4 m/s by the time the front wheels reach it, then cross it steadily, without braking, accelerating or steering sharply (choose `slow_for_ice`; `car.target_speed` already slows for it). Leave more room to anything ahead: on the ice the car can hardly stop. Objects beyond 80 m or behind buildings are unseen; an empty traffic list does not prove the road is clear. Decide whether the car should keep moving or hold still right now.

criteria.drive: Keep moving: cruising, slowing down, or rolling up to a stop line that is not reached yet all count as driving. Use this while safely approaching a line, obstacle, crossing pedestrian (including mid-block), or destination still ahead; slow or brake as needed.
criteria.stop: Hold completely still right now. Correct only when the car is already at the line (`intersection.distance` is "at") with a red or unseen signal, a stop not yet completed, or a roundabout yield line with `ring_traffic` true, when a pedestrian is crossing right in front (`pedestrian.distance` is "at"), when the path directly ahead is blocked, or when the car has reached the destination.
